items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: and then later on, because I had gotten to know him, he signed my book, the book that he wrote, yeah.

ctx.x: And when you did, when you did, and you knew something about them, they were the most easy people to speak to. Yeah. I did that with one movie theater. Willie “The Lion” Smith was playing and I went up and spoke to him and he handed me his card and it had

Jewish writing on it. He was a cantor. So I mean, and then later on, because I had gotten to know him, he signed my book, the book that he wrote, yeah. So coming here, I mean it was kind of upside down you know. I had this hero image.
